content: Debounced persistence durability traps: reset-on-every-write debounce never fires under sustained writes (starvation) - debounce must be bounded (leading+trailing or max-wait cap); if writes are confirmed only after a dump containing them, starvation turns into permanent Unavailability. Dump serialization under the map RWMutex stalls all reads/writes for the whole dump - snapshot under short RLock then serialize outside. A dump containing a write must be defined by a captured version watermark, not by which writes happened to land in the JSON. fsync latency spikes (1-4ms SSD, more on HDD; ext4 journal commit) gate the confirm path - bursts coalesce into one dump which is the intended group-commit-like behavior.
